name: Berger Paints

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: EPS

unitGuard.reason: unit guard: the EPS row for FY2023 read 0.1537 against 1.61753 for that period's net profit divided by the shares on file, a factor of 0.09502, which is the 10x reciprocal of a per-share figure printed in a sub-unit (kobo / cents / a thousandth). Normalised to 1.537, the unit the price is quoted in.

unit guard: the EPS row for FY2022 read 0.072 against 0.71999 for that period's net profit divided by the shares on file, a factor of 0.1, which is the 10x reciprocal of a per-share figure printed in a sub-unit (kobo / cents / a thousandth). Normalised to 0.72, the unit the price is quoted in.

unit guard: the EPS row for FY2021 read 0.0468 against 0.467992 for that period's net profit divided by the shares on file, a factor of 0.1, which is the 10x reciprocal of a per-share figure printed in a sub-unit (kobo / cents / a thousandth). Normalised to 0.468, the unit the price is quoted in.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed

derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
source_note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47723_BERGER_PAINTS_NIGERIA_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
